AGENDA
PLANNING COMMISSION
MEETING
Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at (310) 378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
Any person who has made campaign contributions to any of the members of the Planning Commission within twelve months before this meeting, should examine the provisions of Government Code Section 84308 which is posted on the bulletin board outside the Council Chamber.
We are advised by the members of the Commission that none of them have received campaign contributions within the last twelve months.
The applicant or any property owner entitled to notice of the hearing may, within fifteen days after the date of the Planning Commission decision, appeal the Planning Commission decision to the City Council (Ord. No. 091-529). A fee is required for filing an appeal with the City Clerkâ€™s office (R05-14).
The Council may, within fifteen days after the date of the decision or on or before the first date following the first Council meeting after the date of the Planning Commission decision, whichever occurs last: 1) Confirm the action of the Planning Commission and grant or deny the application; 2) Set the matter for public hearing and dispose of it in the same manner as on an appeal; or 3) Amend, modify, delete or add any condition of approval which the Council finds is not substantial under the circumstances relative to or affecting the property subject to the application for a development entitlement. Any determination of the Council pursuant to this paragraph shall be conclusive and final.
The Planning Commission reserves the right to modify the order of items shown on the agenda and advises all interested parties to arrive promptly at the commencement of the meeting.

ACTION MINUTES
  PLANNING COMMISSION
  MAY 21, 2019

Council Chambers  Tuesday
City Hall  May 21, 2019
340 Palos Verdes Drive West  6:30 p.m.
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

Present: Thomas, Criley, Lazarro, & Walker
Absent: Chang
Also present: Contract City Planner Jeffrey Graham, Planning Manager Brianna Rindge,
Assistant City Attorney John Cotti, Community Development & Public Works Director Ken
Rukavina

COMMUNICATIONS FROM PUBLIC – None

ACTION MINUTES

Meeting of May 21, 2019.

CONSENT CALENDAR

1.  NC-1649-19 (RESOLUTION NO. PCR-2019-1127); Consideration of a Neighborhood
  Compatibility Application for extension of an existing second-floor balcony at the single-
  family residence located at 1721 Via Coronel. Lot 4, Block 4, Tract 7334. This project is
  exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section
  15303.

  Applicant:  Andy Santonello, 25030 Narbonne Ave, Lomita CA 90717
  Owner:  Zahra Tabassian

  Action: Criley moved and Lazzaro seconded to approve the application on consent (4-0 in
  favor, Chang absent) with standard conditions.

2.  NC-1652-19 (RESOLUTION NO. PCR-2019-1125); Consideration of a Neighborhood
  Compatibility Application for additions to the single-family residence located at 3628 Via
  Palomino. Lots 8 & portion of 9, Block 6216, Tract 6887. This project is exempt from
  CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

Planning Commission  1
Action Minutes
May 21, 2019
   Applicant/Owner: Mr. & Mrs. Russell Barto, 3628 Via Palomino, Palos Verdes Estates

  Action: Criley moved and Lazzaro seconded to approve the application on consent (4-0 in
  favor, Chang absent) with standard conditions and the following additional condition: 1) The
  driveway approach shall be constructed per City Standards as approved by the City Engineer.

3.  M-1309-19 (RESOLUTION NO. PCR-2019-1128); Consideration of a Miscellaneous
  Application for walls exceeding 42” within setback adjacent to the street at a single-family
  residence located at 960 Paseo La Cresta. Lot 9, Tract 31329. This project is exempt from
  CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant:  Tomaro Architecture, 2617 N. Sepulveda Blvd, Manhattan Beach, CA 90266
  Owner:  Jason & Pauline Li

  Action: Criley moved and Lazzaro seconded to approve the application on consent (4-0 in
  favor, Chang absent) with standard conditions and the following additional conditions: 1)
  The stairs are a non-standard encroachment and shall be removed. 2) A public sewer line
  runs on the property alongside and parallel to the rear property line. The developer shall
  determine the actual location, alignment and condition of the sewer mainline, confirmed by
  video surveillance and report. No object, whether a permanent structure, or a temporary
  structure, or any object which is difficult to remove are allowed within sewer easements.

4.  M-1310-19 (RESOLUTION NO. PCR-2019-1129); Consideration of a Miscellaneous
  Application for walls exceeding 42” within setback adjacent to the street at a single-family
  residence located at 588 Via Almar. Lot 9, Block 1426, Tract 8523. This project is exempt
  from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant:  Jose Cabrera, 430 Lecouvreur Ave, Wilmington, CA 90744
  Owner:  Nader Ghaderi

  Action: Criley moved and Lazzaro seconded to approve the application on consent (4-0 in
  favor, Chang absent) with standard conditions and the following additional conditions: 1)
  The existing walkway is a nonstandard encroachment and shall be removed. 2) No object,
  whether a permanent structure, temporary structure, or any object which is difficult to
  remove are allowed within sewer easements.

NEW BUSINESS

5.  NC-1596/G-1599/M-1189-17 (RESOLUTION NO. PCR-2019-1126); Consideration of
  Neighborhood Compatibility, Grading & Miscellaneous Applications for a new single-
  family residence located at 1657 Via Arriba. Lot 3, Block 1436, Tract 6884. This project is
  exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section
  15303.

Planning Commission  2
Action Minutes
May 21, 2019
   Applicant:  Curt Dittman, 5117 Macafee Rd, Torrance, CA 90505
  Owner:  Amir Aatari

  Action: Criley moved and Lazzaro seconded to approve the application (4-0 in favor, Chang
  absent) with standard conditions and the following additional conditions: 1) The proposed
  sidewalk is a nonstandard encroachment and shall be removed. 2) The driveway, curb, and
  gutter shall be constructed per City Standards. 3) A public sewer line runs on the property
  alongside and parallel to the westerly and rear property line. The developer shall determine
  the actual location, alignment, and condition of the sewer mainline, confirmed by video
  surveillance and report. 4) No object, whether a permanent structure, or a temporary
  structure, or any object which is difficult to remove are allowed within sewer easements. 5)
  This project is considered Hillside Residential and shall comply with Municipal NPDES
  Permit. 6) Runoff from watershed tributary to the boundaries of the proposed project shall be
  intercepted and conveyed through the site to an approved drainage outlet.

ITEMS OF INFORMATION

6.  Zoning text amendment to the City’s municipal code amending Section 18.28 to establish
  procedures and standards for outdoor lighting in the R-1 single-family residential and R-M
  multifamily residential zones.

  Speakers: Scott Alden, Marlene Breene

  Action: Continued to June meeting.

7.  Administrative Approvals. – Reviewed and filed.

  Speakers: Lynne LaFleur, Marlene Breene

8.  Art Jury Meeting Schedule – Reviewed and filed.

ACTION MINUTES

9.  Meeting of April 16, 2019.

  Action: Lazarro moved and Criley seconded to approve as written (4-0 in favor, Chang
  absent).

Adjourned at 8:08 pm

Adjourn to the Planning Commission meeting on Tuesday, June 18, 2019 at 6:30 PM

This Planning Commission meeting can be viewed via live-stream or on demand thereafter on
the City website at www.pvestates.org.

Planning Commission  3
